name: Theme manager
author: Brett
description: Roll colour, style and layout themes, or every themeable part at once. A tree of every token (built from the asset types, so new types show up by themselves) with tri-state ticks, locks, presets and search picks what a roll may change; rolls stay readable (contrast-checked palettes, sizes within the range the known themes use). Live preview, undo/redo, pin favourites, edit any value by hand, save a roll as standard asset@1 themes and manage them (apply, rename, duplicate, export, import, delete). Phone: drill-down tree. Skin Builder (skin-sections@1, Nov 10 2026): every skin is a package of sections (colours, design, layout, behaviour, typography, density, sizing, icons, controls, chrome, parts), each its own asset; drag slices from the library into the pack template, preview the whole console live, save, apply, export or import as a file. Applying a skin picks which sections to take; a mix of skins is saved as a new skin. Nav → Plugins → Theme manager / Skin Builder; Settings → Plugins → Themes.
